summary.text:
The paper on disk for Rhondda Cynon Taf is document 57655 for the Central South Consortium Joint Committee on 27 January 2026 — a three-page covering report from the Treasurer of the Central South Consortium Joint Education Service (CSC JES) Joint Committee, asking members to approve the audited Statement of Accounts for the five-month closedown period 1 April 2025 to 31 August 2025. The Joint Committee is being wound down 'in line with its legal agreement' (para 1.1). RCT is the Host Authority, which is why the paper sits on RCT's ModernGov. The accounts are the consortium's, not RCT's.

The paper carries no treasury content whatsoever. No CFR, no external borrowing, no PWLB, no maturity profile, no weighted rate, no prudential indicator, no MRP policy, no IFRS 16 restatement, no liability benchmark, no LOBO or investment portfolio. The only financial figure printed is a £174k General Reserve balance for the wound-down education consortium (para 3.4). The named background papers are Appendix 1 (Statement of Accounts) and Appendix 2 (Letter of Representation) — both attach to the CSC JES Joint Committee, not RCT.

Per PIPELINE.md, this is exactly the case where the correct action is 'write the note recording exactly that and draft nothing. A thin note is far better than a padded one'. Loan-book reconciliation is not applicable — there is no paper claim to tie our file to. Balance-sheet identity cannot be run — no CFR to test. No temporal rate move to derive — no market view in the paper.

Recorded internally only: our file at 2026-03-31 for RHONDDA CYNON TAFF COUNTY BOROUGH C (borrower name verified via price_book.py --find) holds 28 loans, £187,085,205 principal, weighted 3.5843%, profile mix 17 MATURITY / 11 EIP. The break-cost engine returns a net indicative discount of £17.72m (9.7% of principal), concentrated in three long-dated 4.48%-4.60% MATURITY loans plus one 1.41% EIP. Both figures are held here for a real RCT treasury paper when one lands; they are not for this Joint Education Consortium paper and nothing about RCT's position is asserted from it.

Contact printed on this paper is Stephanie Davies (01443 424026), Service Director – Financial Services and Treasurer to the Joint Committee — a role she holds because RCT is the Host Authority. No email published. Two other RCT-tagged PDFs are on disk (a November 2025 pension-fund appendix and an 11 February 2026 later-version CSC JES closedown cover); neither is a companion to this paper and neither is an RCT treasury paper. A real RCT treasury paper would sit on RCT's own Council, Cabinet or Audit agenda, not the CSC JES Joint Committee.

Status: read-thin. No email drafted — there is nothing here for a treasurer that isn't already public in this administrative closedown.
